title: Log Trap
text: Attack with a friendly unit. Then attack with it again, even if it's exhausted. It can't attack bases for the second attack.
rules:
If you play Log Trap, you must attack with a unit twice, if able. The unit must be ready to attack the first time.
Fully resolve the first attack, including all triggers, before beginning the second attack.
Units that can’t attack bases can still damage bases through other abilities, like Overwhelm.
